summary.title: Metro Rail Networks & Rapid Transit of India
summary.lead_agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India

cities.name: Delhi-NCR (DMRC & RRTS)
cities.operator: Delhi Metro Rail Corp (DMRC) / NCRTC / NMRC
cities.rolling_stock: Rotem / BEML, Bombardier Movia, Alstom Metropolis
cities.description: The benchmark of modern Indian urban infrastructure. Spanning 393 km across the National Capital Territory of Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, and Gurugram, Delhi Metro is the fifth largest rapid transit system on earth by network length. Spearheaded by Dr. E. Sreedharan, the project broke global civil engineering records for punctuality, underground shield tunneling beneath historic Shahjahanabad, and regenerative braking carbon credits registered under the UN Clean Development Mechanism.

quote.text: The Delhi Metro is not merely a transport system; it is a cultural transformation of urban life in India. It proved that an Indian public-sector engineering enterprise could build world-class infrastructure within budget and ahead of time without political interference.
quote.author: Dr. E. Sreedharan
quote.title: Founding Managing Director, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation
quote.source: Memoirs of the Metro Man & DMRC Project Monograph (2012)

engineering_feats: Chawri Bazar underground station excavated 30 meters beneath 350-year-old walled city structures using earth-pressure balance TBMs.
First railway project in the world to earn 2.8 million carbon credits under the UNFCCC for regenerative electric braking.
Namo Bharat (Delhi-Meerut RRTS) operating at 160 km/h with European Train Control System (ETCS) Level-2 signalling.

lines.terminals: Samaypur Badli ↔ Millennium City Centre Gurugram

lines.terminals: Noida Electronic City / Vaishali ↔ Dwarka Sector 21

lines.terminals: Brigadier Hoshiar Singh ↔ Inderlok / Kirti Nagar

lines.name: Airport Express (Orange Line)
lines.terminals: New Delhi Station ↔ Yashobhoomi Dwarka Sec 25

cities.name: Mumbai (MMRDA & MMMOCL)
cities.traction: 25 kV AC overhead & 750 V DC third rail
cities.description: Transforming the high-density linear geography of Mumbai. Anchored by the fully operational Line 1 (Versova-Andheri-Ghatkopar), Line 2A (Yellow), Line 7 (Red), and the landmark 33.5 km underground Aqua Line 3 (Colaba-Bandra-SEEPZ), the network bypasses notorious road chokepoints along the Western Express Highway and connects international airport terminals directly with the Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) financial district.

quote.text: The opening of the underground Aqua Line 3 beneath Mumbai's basalt rock geology marks the single largest leap in commuter relief for the island city since the suburban railway began operating in 1853.
quote.author: Dr. Sanjay Mukherjee, IAS
quote.title: Metropolitan Commissioner, MMRDA
quote.source: Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority Infrastructure Report (2024)

engineering_feats: Aqua Line 3 tunneling through dense volcanic basalt using 17 dual-mode tunnel boring machines beneath live railway tracks and heritage buildings.
Cable-stayed bridge over the Western Express Highway and railway tracks at Andheri.
Underground stations engineered with platform screen doors (PSDs) and regenerative water recycling.

cities.name: Bengaluru (Namma Metro)
cities.traction: 750 V DC third rail bottom collection
cities.rolling_stock: BEML / Hyundai Rotem, CRRC (Yellow Line CBTC)
cities.description: Connecting the technology capital of India. Namma Metro spans the 43.5 km Purple Line from Challaghatta to the IT corridor of Whitefield and the 33.5 km Green Line from BIEC Madavara to Silk Institute. With the driverless Yellow Line to Electronics City and the 58 km Blue Line to Kempegowda International Airport under Phase 2B, Namma Metro is transforming urban mobility in South India.

quote.text: The full commissioning of the Purple Line across the Kempegowda Majestic underground interchange into Whitefield created a contiguous 43.5 km rapid transit axis, taking over 150,000 vehicles off Bengaluru roads daily.
quote.author: Anjum Parwez, IAS
quote.title: Managing Director, BMRCL
quote.source: BMRCL Operational Chronicles & Urban Commute Synthesis (2024)

engineering_feats: Underground tunneling through hard granitic gneisses beneath historic Bangalore City Railway Station and Cubbon Park.
First Indian metro system to deploy bottom-contact 750 V DC third-rail technology for safety and aesthetic clearance.
Grade-separated elevated viaduct over the bustling Outer Ring Road (ORR) and flyover intersections.

cities.name: Kolkata (India's Pioneer & Underwater Metro)
cities.description: The birthplace of rapid rail in India. Operational since 1984, Kolkata Metro made history again in 2024 with the commissioning of the 520-meter underwater Hooghly River tunnel on the Green Line—the first underwater transportation tunnel anywhere in South Asia. Trains plunge 33 meters below the surface to link the historic railway terminus of Howrah Maidan directly with Esplanade and Salt Lake Sector V.

quote.text: Passing under the river Hooghly inside a concrete-lined shield tunnel in 45 seconds was a dream envisioned for decades. It stands as an epochal civil engineering feat in the history of Indian Railways.
quote.author: P. Uday Kumar Reddy
quote.title: General Manager, Metro Railway Kolkata

engineering_feats: First sub-riverine tunnel in South Asia: 520m twin tunnels bored beneath the active silt bed of the mighty Hooghly River.
Howrah Metro station engineered 33 meters underground, making it India's deepest metro station.
Integration with Howrah and Sealdah railway stations—the two busiest passenger railway terminals in the world.

lines.name: Green Line (Line 2 - Underwater)
lines.terminals: Howrah Maidan ↔ Salt Lake Sector V

cities.name: Chennai (CMRL)
cities.description: Connecting the Coromandel coast metropolis. Chennai Metro Phase 1 spans 54.1 km connecting Chennai International Airport with Puratchi Thalaivar Dr. M.G. Ramachandran Central Railway Station. Under Phase 2, CMRL is constructing an enormous 118.9 km network across three corridors, including undersea and lake tunnel alignments.

quote.text: Chennai Metro Phase 2, with 118.9 km of arterial rail network, will bring over 65% of Greater Chennai's population within an 800-meter walk of high-capacity rapid transit.
quote.author: M.A. Siddique, IAS
quote.title: Managing Director, CMRL
quote.source: Chennai Metro Rail Limited Annual Monograph (2024)

cities.name: Hyderabad (HMRL & L&T)
cities.hindi: हैदराबाद मेट्रो (विश्व की सबसे बड़ी पीपीपी परियोजना)
cities.operator: L&T Metro Rail / Hyderabad Metro Rail Ltd (HMRL)
cities.description: The world's largest elevated public-private partnership (PPP) metro project. Hyderabad Metro links the twin cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad across 69.2 km. The high-capacity Blue Line crosses the HITEC City technology corridor, carrying over 530,000 software professionals and citizens daily with CBTC automatic train operation.

quote.text: Hyderabad Metro stands as a global case study in PPP delivery of mega urban transit, seamlessly integrating multimodal interchanges at Ameerpet and MGBS with zero public subsidy burden on operation.
quote.author: N.V.S. Reddy
quote.title: Managing Director, Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited

cities.name: Kochi (Metro & Electric Water Metro)
cities.hindi: कोच्चि मेट्रो एवं जल मेट्रो (विश्व में प्रथम)
cities.rolling_stock: Alstom Metropolis & Cochin Shipyard Electric Boats
cities.description: A pioneering dual-mode rapid transit model. Kochi Metro features a 28.1 km elevated rail network alongside the world's first urban electric Water Metro network spanning 78 km across 10 island terminals. Powered by lithium-titanate battery vessels manufactured at Cochin Shipyard, Kochi Water Metro connects backwater islands with the mainland IT and commercial core with zero local emissions.

quote.text: The Kochi Water Metro redefines water-based public mobility. By integrating 78 route km of electric ferry corridors with our metro rail feeder backbone, we gave backwater islanders first-world rapid transit equity.
quote.author: Loknath Behera, IPS (Retd.)
quote.title: Managing Director, KMRL

lines.name: Water Metro: High Court ↔ Fort Kochi

cities.name: Ahmedabad & Gandhinagar (GMRC)
cities.hindi: अहमदाबाद एवं गांधीनगर मेट्रो (गिफ्ट सिटी लिंक)
cities.description: Connecting the twin cities of Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar. GMRC operates the East-West Corridor (Thaltej Gam to Vastral Gam) and North-South Corridor (APMC to Motera Narendra Modi Stadium), with Phase 2 extending directly into GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City) and the Gujarat State Secretariat at Gandhinagar.

quote.text: The metro corridor connecting Motera Stadium with GIFT City establishes a high-speed arterial link between the industrial heartbeat of Ahmedabad and India's international financial services center.
quote.author: GMRC Directorate
quote.title: MoHUA Progress Review
quote.source: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Annual Report (2024)

cities.name: Pune (Maha Metro & PMRDA)
cities.operator: Maharashtra Metro Rail Corp (Maha Metro) / PMRDA
cities.description: Decongesting the cultural and automotive hub of Maharashtra. Pune Metro features the Purple Line from PCMC to Swargate (with an underground tunnel beneath the historic Kasba Peth) and the Aqua Line from Vanaz to Ramwadi, converging at the multi-level Civil Court interchange station.

quote.text: The completion of Pune's Swargate underground corridor through the Mutha river basin delivers high-speed transit directly into the historic heart of Pune, slashing commute times by over 60%.
quote.author: Dr. Brijesh Dixit
quote.title: Managing Director, Maha Metro

cities.name: Uttar Pradesh Metros (Lucknow, Kanpur & Agra)
cities.hindi: उत्तर प्रदेश मेट्रो (लखनऊ, कानपुर एवं आगरा)
cities.traction: 25 kV AC overhead & 750 V DC third rail
cities.description: Pioneering tier-2 city rapid transit. UPMRC has delivered the fastest completed metro projects in India across Lucknow (Chaudhary Charan Singh Airport to Munshi Pulia, 22.8 km), Kanpur (IIT Kanpur to Motijheel), and Agra (Taj East Gate to Mankameshwar Temple / Agra Fort).

quote.text: From completing the Lucknow Metro ahead of schedule to unveiling the Agra Metro priority corridor touching the Taj Mahal within 23 months of groundbreaking, UPMRC set new velocity benchmarks for Indian civil projects.
quote.author: Kumar Keshav
quote.title: Former Managing Director, UPMRC
